```{r}
data$best_cp_clean <- str_replace_all(data$best_cp, "\\[|\\]", "")

#separar las coordenadas en 3 columnas numéricas (z, x, y)
data <- data %>%
  separate(best_cp_clean, into = c("cp_z", "cp_x", "cp_y"), sep = ",", convert = TRUE)

data
```

```{r}
glimpse(data)
```
```{r}
min_f <- min(data$best_f, na.rm=TRUE)


cat("el minimo ratio: ", min_f)

```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data, aes(x = best_f)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2/9, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = 2/9, y = 500, label = "Cota 2/9", color = "red", angle = 90, vjust = -0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribución del Radio de Oertel (best_f)",
       x = "Valor de best_f",
       y = "Frecuencia (Cantidad de pruebas)")


```

```{r}
library(plotly)

#filtrar solo el 5% de los casos que tienen menor best_f
cuantil_5per <- quantile(data$best_f, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
data_lowest_f <- data %>% filter(best_f <= cuantil_5per)


plot_ly(data_lowest_f, x = ~cp_z, y = ~cp_x, z = ~cp_y, 
        type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(size = 3, 
                      color = ~best_f, 
                      colorscale = 'Viridis', 
                      showscale = TRUE)) %>%
  layout(title = "Ubicación de los Centerpoints (Top 5% más bajo f)",
         scene = list(xaxis = list(title = 'Fibra Z'),
                      yaxis = list(title = 'Eje X'),
                      zaxis = list(title = 'Eje Y')))

```
